recommendation: Resolve all three findings and re-review exact revised bytes before WBS build.

findings.claim: A candidate-equal restart may finalize an APPLIED transition from candidate equality and strict validation alone, without durable proof that the edge-specific live authority/readiness checks and authorized guarded writer produced those bytes.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed candidate-equal recovery lacks durable authorized-writer provenance.

findings.claim: The source-equal charge restart requires a new boundary receipt but reuses an immutable intent whose exact candidate bytes/hash were pinned before that new observation; the design defines no way to bind the new receipt into the unchanged candidate ledger bytes.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed a fresh charge receipt cannot bind the immutable old intent/candidate.

findings.claim: The closed four-effect pre-charge write set contains no operation that can persist the fresh path-and-hash receipt artifacts required for live P7–P11 and P14 evidence before the AdmissionBundle is sealed, while prepare is explicitly read-only.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed fresh pre-charge evidence persistence is missing from closed effects.

residual_risks: Transition recovery provenance and pre-charge evidence persistence remain incomplete until revision.
